eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- patients who are continued on 6-monthly subcutaneous injection of DEN in either the ROMO or DEN arms after month 48; (2) those who are willing to have a repeat DXA assessment at the end of 6 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients who refuse to be maintained on denosumab after month 48
* patients who are maintained on other anti-osteoporotic drugs after month 48
* patients in whom prednisolone is planned to be tapered or discontinued after month 48.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Romosozumab Versus Denosumab In Glucocorticoid-induced Osteoporosis: An Extended Observation Of a Clinical Trial at 6 Years
